Package frc.spectrumLib.mechanism

Class Mechanism

java.lang.Object
frc.spectrumLib.mechanism.Mechanism
All Implemented Interfaces:
Subsystem
Direct Known Subclasses:
FuelIntake, Hood, IndexerBed, IndexerTower, IntakeExtension, IntakeExtension.IntakeExtensionRight, Launcher
public abstract class Mechanism extends Object implements Subsystem
Base class for a CTRE TalonFX-driven mechanism: motor creation, cached sensor reads, control mode helpers, threshold triggers, and periodic current reporting.

With Mechanism.Config.isAttached() false, the mechanism builds no hardware, commands nothing, and every sensor read returns 0.

target and velocityTarget hold the last setpoint this class sent to the motor, which is what the at-target triggers compare against.

Everything here is in CTRE Phoenix 6 units, so rotations and rotations per second rather than degrees, and the mechanism's gearing is Config.talonConfig.Feedback.SensorToMechanismRatio. A subclass supplies a Mechanism.Config holding its motor IDs, Talon settings, followers, and rotation bounds.

    • setPositionWithVelocity

      protected void setPositionWithVelocity(DoubleSupplier rotations, DoubleSupplier velocityRPS)
      Position control with an explicit velocity feedforward. This is the right primitive for a continuously moving setpoint, such as a turret tracking a target while the robot drives, where a profiled motion would leave steady-state lag.
      Parameters:
      rotations - the target position in mechanism rotations
      velocityRPS - the feedforward in mechanism rotations per second

      jerk - in rotations per second cubed

    • toggleReverseSoftLimit

      public void toggleReverseSoftLimit(boolean enabled)
      Enables or disables the reverse software limit and applies the change immediately. The threshold comes from the current configuration.

    • toggleTorqueCurrentLimit

      public void toggleTorqueCurrentLimit(DoubleSupplier enabledLimit, boolean enabled)
      Enables or disables a forward and reverse torque current limit and applies the change immediately. Disabling resets the peak to plus or minus 300 A, which is effectively unlimited.
      Parameters:
      enabledLimit - the torque current limit in amps, applied when enabled is true

    • toggleSupplyCurrentLimit

      public void toggleSupplyCurrentLimit(DoubleSupplier enabledLimit, boolean enabled)
      Enables or disables the supply current limit and applies the change immediately.
      Parameters:
      enabledLimit - the supply current limit in amps

    • applyCurrentLimit

      public void applyCurrentLimit(DoubleSupplier supplyLimit, DoubleSupplier statorLimit)
      Applies new supply and stator current limits, in amps, but only when they differ from the configured ones. The apply is retried while CanConfigBudget.maxAttempts() allows it.

    • checkAvgCurrent

      public Command checkAvgCurrent(DoubleSupplier expectedCurrent, DoubleSupplier tolerance)
      Averages the stator current over the command's runtime and raises a warning Alert if the average is further than tolerance from expectedCurrent.
      Parameters:
      expectedCurrent - the expected average stator current in amps
      tolerance - the largest acceptable deviation in amps

    • checkMaxCurrent

      public Command checkMaxCurrent(DoubleSupplier expectedCurrent)
      Tracks the peak stator current and raises a warning Alert if it exceeds expectedCurrent.
      Parameters:
      expectedCurrent - the highest acceptable peak stator current in amps

    • checkMinThresholdCurrent

      public Command checkMinThresholdCurrent(DoubleSupplier expectedCurrent)
      Tracks the peak stator current and raises a warning Alert if it never reaches expectedCurrent, which checks that a mechanism drew at least its expected load.
      Parameters:
      expectedCurrent - the lowest acceptable peak stator current in amps
